resources.string: A modernised rootless Xposed framework manager and APK patching utility.

NPatch helps you patch APKs, attach Xposed modules, manage module scopes, and keep runtime logs without requiring a rooted device. Local mode is designed for apps managed on this device, while integrated mode can package modules into a patched app for devices without the manager.
Please configure the necessary system permissions to ensure NPatch functions correctly.
Required for reading source APKs and exporting patched binaries to your device.
Allows NPatch to retrieve installed applications for accurate patching target selection.
Review these operational risks before patching applications or loading modules.

Patching applications may lead to instability, data corruption, or compatibility failures. Ensure critical data is backed up. You are solely responsible for the conduct of patched apps and modules on your device.
